responsibility: This file implements GC-implementation-independent support for GCC’s garbage-collected allocator. It manages root-table marking, including dynamically registered plugin roots, provides generic helpers for cleared allocation, reallocation, and GGC-backed helpers used by containers such as hash tables and splay trees, drives common GC/PCH traversal support, computes GC heuristics, and owns per-site GGC memory-accounting and reporting logic that records allocation, freed, collected, and overhead statistics across whichever concrete collector backend is in use.
